title: FreeRDP before 3.33.0 contains a heap out-of-bounds write in h264_context_reset() in libfreerdp/codec/h264.c, which…
description: FreeRDP versions prior to 3.33.0 contain a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the h264_context_reset() function within libfreerdp/codec/h264.c. This flaw occurs because new dimensions are stored before the YUV planes are reallocated, allowing remote peers to trigger surface height increases that cause avc420_compress() to write beyond the allocated memory for luma and chroma planes. This can lead to heap memory corruption or process crashes.
